title: Integrability of a Bernoulli coordinate indicator
statement: Let $p\in[0,1]$, let $k$ be a natural number, and let $i$ be a coordinate in $\{0,\ldots,k-1\}$. Under the product measure on $k$ independent Bernoulli-$p$ bits, the indicator of whether coordinate $i$ equals true is integrable.
hypotheses_covered: $i$ is a coordinate in the finite index set of size $k$
